pr_title: DT accessors with defaults + default flags to 0
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/25827 

Add generic accessors for devicetree property values which accept defaults, and then use them to make all DT_FOO_FLAGS() APIs just return 0 if there are no flags set in the DT.

CC @NZSmartie
pr_comments: BK errors look unrelated. I will wait for the infra issues to get fixed then re-run.

issue_context.title: Devicetree: add accessors with defaults
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**

It's inconvenient to get a devicetree property if it exists and substitute a default if it isn't. This should be fixed, and also fixed for cells, in particular 'flags' cells.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

Add macros for "get me this property value if it exists, or this default value otherwise".

We should do the same for "get me this cell value if it exists, or this default otherwise", and reasonable extensions thereof, like "get me this flags value **or zero**".

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Continued use of tricky macros like COND_CODE_1 is too complex and under-documented.

**Additional context**

https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/25394#discussion_r432396778
